claim: The arXiv 2605.27716 study compares a deterministic axe-core pipeline against an LLM agent on HTML pages. It covers detection (RQ1), remediation (RQ2) and cost. Its stated result is that iterative agent-based remediation raises computational cost without improving repair effectiveness. In the snippets I retrieved, the per-defect-type detection numbers are not visible, so I cannot report which defect types each approach missed in that paper. Next step: read the full paper's results tables.
